_meta.description: The labels used on Maester pull requests, issues and discussions. The rules for applying them are in .github/skills/maester-triage/SKILL.md. Edit this file, then run ./build/github/Sync-GitHubLabels.ps1 to create, rename and recolour the labels in the repository.
_meta.renamedFrom: An entry's 'renamedFrom' lists the old label names. The sync script renames the first existing one, which keeps it on every item, and merges any others into it.

labels.name: status: needs triage
labels.description: Waiting for a maintainer to look at it

labels.name: status: needs review
labels.description: Waiting for a maintainer to review

labels.name: status: changes requested
labels.description: A maintainer asked for changes; waiting on the author

labels.name: status: needs decision
labels.description: Needs a maintainer decision before work can continue

labels.name: status: blocked
labels.description: Waiting on another pull request, issue or upstream change

labels.name: status: in progress
labels.description: Someone is working on it (draft PR, or an issue with an owner or linked PR)

labels.name: status: needs info
labels.description: Waiting for the reporter to answer a question

labels.name: status: accepted
labels.description: Confirmed and wanted; nobody has started it

labels.name: status: awaiting confirmation
labels.description: A fix has shipped; waiting for the reporter to confirm

labels.name: status: tracked
labels.description: Tracked in a linked issue or pull request

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: A new feature or an improvement to an existing one

labels.name: new test
labels.description: Adds a new check, or asks for one

labels.name: maintenance
labels.description: Refactoring, build, CI or repository housekeeping; no user-visible change

labels.name: area: tests
labels.description: The checks under tests/ and the helpers they call

labels.name: area: engine
labels.description: Core Maester: Invoke-Maester, the test engine, console, configuration and cmdlets

labels.name: area: connections
labels.description: Connect-Maester, sign-in, tokens and the service connections

labels.name: area: report
labels.description: The HTML, Markdown and JSON report and the result exports

labels.name: area: packs
labels.description: Maester Packs: third-party test packs and connectors

labels.name: area: build & ci
labels.description: Build scripts, generators, GitHub workflows and the Maester GitHub Action

labels.name: area: website
labels.description: maester.dev: docs pages, the blog and the site's own code

labels.name: size: XL
labels.description: 1,500 or more reviewable lines changed; consider splitting

labels.name: breaking change
labels.description: Changes behaviour, a parameter, an output or a test ID that users rely on

labels.name: security-sensitive
labels.description: Touches tokens, secrets, scopes, TLS or workflow permissions; review with care

labels.name: generated
labels.description: Only regenerated files (test docs, fixtures, generated suites)

labels.name: attribute-review-override
labels.description: A maintainer accepts the test's attributes despite the attribute review

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: Already reported elsewhere; link the original when closing

labels.name: superseded
labels.description: Replaced by another pull request; link it when closing

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

labels.name: invalid
labels.description: Not a Maester problem, or not reproducible

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Updates a dependency file (set by Dependabot)
